item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
(Summoned by PM1)This is quality and quantity work, but it goes on too long, and doesn't fulfill any need for me.

Does this entertain me? No, it's too dense and lacks a narrative structure. You could address that by changing it to an orientation tale.

Is it logical in-universe? Not really. It starts as how to handle a lockdown, then veers off into a list of MTFs, while mentioning some material the foundation doesn't trust recruits with2. You could address this by separating it into two works: A new employee's guide to Lockdowns, and a senior review of active MTFs.

Is it helpful to new readers of the wiki? Maybe. A little info on a lot of subjects would not interest me as a new reader.

Footnotes
1. To my complete and happy surprise
2. The origin of the CI, for instance

For skips to consider for the bio-hazardous/infectious section, here are a few suggestion:

  • SCP-2075
  • SCP-1100
  • SCP-2870

For "CERBERUS", I'd suggest SCP-1913 and SCP-1048.

SCP-2059 would probably qualify as a Large Scale Aggressor.

"…anomalous self-sustaining reactions capable of dramatically increasing in severity unless immediately countered."

SCP-2102 fits this somewhat.

item.title: Author Notes
item.content:encoded:
First jab at a manual-style document. I've made efforts to account for new members, by linking to all references so hopefully no inexperienced readers go "what the hell is that?".

This is in no way meant to be a hub, or a canon for people to follow. It conflicts many headcanons of other users. It's my head - incorporating only my ideas - and it's up to you to accept it or not.

No, this is not supposed to be a guide.

It's something I enjoyed writing and I hope you enjoy it too.

Thanks to Banana Republic, tretter, MrWrong, Otmas, Zyn, Weryllium, and a huge thanks to Agent MacLeod for critics and reviews.

If you want me to link your SCP/tale to this, just give me the link, tell me why and where to put it.

EDIT: (5th Sept. 2018) Massive re-write of 04 command, alert code system, lockdown classifications and ARIs.

EDIT EDIT: (8th Sept.) Re-organisation of categories and huge overhaul of aesthetics. Love to hear your opinions on whether it looks better/cleaner this way.
